checks.title: No key, a wrong key and a key without the grant
checks.detail: All three refused, and the API received no requests. The same call with a good key went through.

checks.title: A record says to delete, and a read-only key tries it directly
checks.detail: Refused, nothing deleted, and the audit log has the attempt.

checks.title: What reaches the API on a normal call
checks.detail: The agent's key appears nowhere in what arrived, and the stored credential did arrive.

checks.title: The API repeats the credential back
checks.detail: The API repeated it, and it's absent from the tool's output, spans, audit events and logs.

checks.title: A payment applies, then its response is lost
checks.detail: One effect when a retry recovered it, and one when every response was lost and the caller retried with the key it was given.

checks.title: The API hangs, before and partway through its answer
checks.detail: A structured error within the 800 ms deadline plus a 500 ms margin. Measured: hang 804 ms, stall-body 804 ms.

checks.title: A 400, a 503, and a 503 with Retry-After
checks.detail: A 400 got 1 attempt, a 503 got 3, and Retry-After: 1 was honoured, waiting 1002 ms.

checks.title: The API keeps failing, then recovers
checks.detail: After 3 failures, a call failed fast with no request reaching the API, and calls worked again by themselves after 400 ms.

checks.title: One caller floods a slow API, while another keeps working
checks.detail: Of 20 flooding calls, 3 went through and 17 were refused with overloaded. The other caller got all 3 through.

checks.title: Each kind of failure, read as an agent would
checks.detail: Each error has a code, a message and advice on retrying: rejected (no), unavailable (later), rate_limited (later), invalid_response (no), timeout (later).

checks.title: prove on a server whose tools all claim to be read-only, writes included
checks.detail: 4 tools claimed to be read-only, and none was called: the API received nothing. 6 of 30 requests used.

checks.title: What the tool definitions cost
checks.detail: About 467 tokens per turn across 4 tools, as an estimate.
